remarks: Welcome home to this delightful 2-Bedroom 2-Bath apartment in the heart of downtown Stamford! Step into a bright and airy open-concept living and dining area, complete with large windows that flood the space with natural light. The kitchen features modern appliances, ample cabinetry, and plenty of counter space; perfect for cooking and entertaining. Both bedrooms are generously sized with large closets, ideal for rest and relaxation or a home office setup. Close to the train station and I-95 this unit provides great options for commuters. Don't miss your opportunity to own in one of the most sought out areas of Stamford known for its extensive list of restaurants, cafes, shops, and entertainment!
